description: Finds words the brand says to avoid in a piece of writing, with what to say instead and why. Pass `text`, or a deck (`boardId`) or doc (`docId`) to check its words. Run it on your own drafts before handing them back.

boardId.description: A deck or sketch to check.

kitId.description: A brand kit id from napkin_brand_list. Omit for the workspace's brand.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_brand_check
title: Check writing against the brand
